mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_point_ledger (user_id, biz_type, biz_id, points, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{points}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_point_ledger WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT l.user_id AS userId, l.total AS ledgerSum, l.earned AS ledgerEarned, COALESCE(a.balance, 0) AS balance, COALESCE(a.total_earned, 0) AS totalEarned FROM (SELECT user_id, SUM(points) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN points > 0 THEN points ELSE 0 END) AS earned FROM user_point_ledger GROUP BY user_id) l LEFT JOIN user_point_account a ON a.user_id = l.user_id WHERE COALESCE(a.balance, 0) <> l.total OR COALESCE(a.total_earned, 0) <> l.earned LIMIT #{limit}
